In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the adsorption of aromatic compounds by sediments of the Baotou Channel is a complex process and is influenced by many factors.

the adsorption of phenol, aniline and chlorobenzenes by surface sediments from the upper reaches of the Yellow River is pH-dependent and the adsorption of these three compounds is in the sequence of aniline > chlorobenzene > phenol.
the adsorption isotherm is nonlinear, and the adsorption amount of aromatic compounds is dependent on the concentration, pH and content of organic matters in sediments.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the adsorption amounts of aromatic compounds on the surface sediment of Baotou channel of the Yellow River are influenced by many factors such as pH,ionic strength and the concentration of organic matter in sediment.
the adsorption of aromatic compounds in multiconponent system by surface sediments is a complex process and the adsorption isotherm can be described by Freundlich equation.

the adsorption of aromatic compounds in multiconponent system is a competitive reaction and adsorption amounts of each component are influenced by each other.
